kept.depicts: Two towering five-shelf wooden bookcases packed with gold-banded volumes, flanking a rolling ladder suspended from an overhead rail.
A grey iron screw press with a side gear wheel lowering a platen onto a cream signature marked with brown text bars.
A wooden three-by-three drawer chest on legs with brass pulls, two lower drawers slid open to reveal cream index stock.

kept.name: e:lib-spool
kept.depicts: A wooden bobbin wound with red thread, paying out a bright-tipped horizontal strand to the right.
A two-tier grey metal book trolley on spoked wheels, loaded with colourful gold-banded volumes.
Three stacked brown wooden shipping crates with diagonal slats, each stencilled with .C in cream lettering.
A wooden frame loom strung with vertical red and blue warp threads, a grey heddle bar, and a yellow shuttle passing across.
A wooden filing unit with a closed upper drawer above an open lower tray holding upright white and cream tabbed folders.
A framed dark pinboard with five pale nodes linked by crossing red, yellow, and brown threads.
A wooden pedestal lectern supporting an open cream reference volume with grey text blocks on both pages.
A purple ink pad beside a tiered wooden rubber stamp hovering above a cream slip bearing a fresh purple impression.
A small blue-and-green terrestrial globe mounted in a yellow brass meridian ring on a stepped wooden stand.
A heavy dark-brown leather codex with golden side clasps and a cream cover plate bearing two dark grey title bars.
A yellow brass balance scale on a wooden base with two level brown weighing pans suspended by grey chains.
A wooden-framed glass hourglass with pale sand in the upper bulb and a fuller pile of bright yellow sand below.
